'''Solvek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ubese/Legends|Ubese]], who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Solvek worked as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and once had a falling out with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Draba]], resulting in her attempting to feed him to a [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]]. Solvek escaped and later tried to take an assignment from [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Zerex]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Adinorr]]. However, Zerex was an associate of Draba and when he learned of her grudge against Solvek, he had the bounty hunter arrested and sent to the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|Spice Mines of Kessel]].<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

A group of agents who Solvek had previously had a disagreement with were later imprisoned with him on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], so he sent a some thugs to attack them.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
